Notificacoes.subtitulo: Everything that happens with your bookings, payments and conversations with owners, in real time. Important notices also arrive by email.
Notificacoes.vazioTexto: Updates about your bookings, payments and messages show up here.

lista.quando: When the owner replies to your request, a payment is processed or a message arrives, you'll see it here.

reserva_confirmada.mensagem: The owner confirmed your booking for {item} on {data}. Enjoy your trip!

reserva_recusada.mensagem: The owner couldn't accept your request for {item} on {data}.

reserva_cancelada.mensagem: Your booking for {item} on {data} was canceled.

reserva_expirada.mensagem: The deadline to pay for {item} ({data}) has passed and the request expired. You weren't charged.

reserva_concluida.mensagem: Tell us how {item} went — your review helps other travelers.

aguardando_pagamento.mensagem: The owner accepted {item} for {data}. Pay by {prazo} to secure the date.

pagamento_aprovado.mensagem: We received payment for order #{numero}. Your booking for {item} on {data} is confirmed.
pagamento_aprovado.mensagemAvulso: We received the payment for charge #{numero} ({titulo}), related to {item}.

pagamento_recusado.mensagem: The payment for {item} wasn't approved. You can still pay with another card or Pix by {prazo}.

reembolso.titulo: {parcial, select, sim {Partial refund issued} other {Refund issued}}
reembolso.mensagem: The amount for order #{numero} ({item}) was refunded. How long it takes to show on your statement depends on your bank or card.

mensagem.titulo: {count, plural, one {New message from {remetente}} other {# new messages from {remetente}}}

cobranca_avulsa.mensagemCriada: The owner sent you a charge ({titulo}) related to {item} ({data}). Pay by {prazo}.
cobranca_avulsa.mensagemExpirada: The deadline to pay charge #{numero} ({titulo}) has passed. Nothing was charged.
cobranca_avulsa.mensagemCancelada: The owner canceled charge #{numero} ({titulo}). Nothing was charged.
